note: Issue #104: concept art for Jeanne the paladin from Ben's brief of 2026-11-09 (bare head, stylised French plate, a fleur-de-lys, a one-handed spear and shield, subtle anime). Eight looks varying hair, eyes, face and tabard: stills in the in-game stance with the Pro image model, two more with Ben's knight lending its rendering, six as v3 characters (south shows the face, east is the in-game view) and two as Pro Flash characters to compare the models. All at the 256 canvas.

calls.no_refs_reason: Ben's brief of 2026-11-09 asks for a subtle anime style, away from the realistic knight that is the only approved reference; the concepts are what a new reference is picked from

body.description: Jeanne d'Arc as a young paladin knight, short dark brown hair in a bowl cut, brown eyes, a calm determined face, bare head with her face clearly visible, no helmet, wearing French 15th-century full plate armour, elegant and slightly stylised with gold trim, a royal blue tabard with golden fleurs-de-lys over the breastplate, a one-handed spear in her right hand and a heater shield with a golden fleur-de-lys on her left arm, side view facing right, in a ready fighting stance with the shield forward and the spear levelled. Subtle anime style like a 1990s 2D fighting game sprite: expressive face, slender realistic proportions, clean cel shading. Detailed pixel art, dark selective outline, light from the top left, full body, no background
